Package hadur.bench

Record Class SessionFile

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
hadur.bench.SessionFile
record SessionFile(String opponents, String heap, boolean fresh, boolean wipe, int rounds, String control, String controlJar) extends Record
BENCH-6: a session file says how a rumble client's session is imitated, one key=value per line (# comments and blanks ignored).
  • opponents=FILE: the set (name | aps | jar) fought in list order, once each, through one engine process. The role column carries the opponent's rumble APS so the report can split sub-50 bots from the rest.
  • heap=512M (default) or heap=none: the child JVM's -Xmx, the client's cap, or none.
  • fresh=true: a fresh JVM per battle (the old bench's way), data directory kept. Default false: one JVM for the whole session.
  • wipe=true: delete the robot data directory before every battle. Default false.
  • rounds=N: rounds per battle, default 35.
  • control=ROBOT: BENCH-7, run the same session again with this robot, which cannot be the cause (a sample bot, or an old release); control-jar=JAR installs it when it is not a bundled sample.
